description: You are a Robotics Engineer preparing manufacturing documentation for a machining shop. A FreeCAD model of a T8 lead screw housing bracket already exists at /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/T8_housing_bracket.FCStd. The machine shop requires a formal 2D engineering drawing before they can fabricate the bracket. Create a complete engineering drawing package from this 3D model. The drawing must contain: a front orthographic projection view, a right-side orthographic projection view, a top orthographic projection view, at least one isometric or auxiliary view for overall orientation, and at least 6 critical dimension annotations covering overall envelope dimensions and key hole/feature locations. Log in as ga / password123. Export the finished drawing as a PDF to /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/bracket_drawing.pdf. Save the updated FreeCAD document (with the drawing page added) to /home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/bracket_drawing.FCStd.
